_doc: A recording of the screen corpus: one program on one system, from the session's first byte to the end of one state's measurement by probe P19 (ADR-030). tests/unit/shared/screen-corpus.test.ts says how it is read and checked; its rows are in the .rows.json file beside it.
machine: the Windows test machine (Windows 11, build 22621), node-pty's bundled ConPTY
source: probe P19 (helper/probes/p19-record.cjs), the test machine's second run of probe P19 (2026-11-19 to 20): codex-bundled-short-1.jsonl, its events up to the end of the after-reply measurement (87344 of 87741 bytes)

events.keys: p19 short: print the probe's short reply
